notes.title: Hot Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Specter Hot Fixes[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32451255/4d8bb02811a1b9a5684181f186b8cfa9e1e9f972.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Added the ability to add scene objects in front of the camera by holding Left Shift and clicking the element you want to add.
[*] Added UI button on the main toolbar for resetting Camera position.
[*] Camera now resets when starting a new scene or loading an existing scene.
[*] Made a few updates to the IK Posable Characters. The elbow's and knee's now have bending support. You can now "Dab".
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32451255/2a6b39fc4c46d24b00bd11f7327118b5bc0fb00b.jpg[/img]

Thanks!
